description: DANCEB crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C74 H43 Cl8 Er3 N8 O10,6(C1 H1 Cl3). From the CIF bond table, Er1 (Er) has 4 O neighbors; Er2 (Er) has 4 O neighbors; Er3 (Er) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.457-3.462 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 93.90-97.62°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula Er3(Q5Cl)8(CH3COO)·6CHCl3.
